llm.summary: This planning skill is not malware, but it can automatically continue into other skills, share the full brainstorming context, and write project files without a clear confirmation gate.

dimensions.detail: The skill's brainstorming purpose is coherent, but it expands into required War Room deliberation, automatic specification handoff, and review-loop orchestration that go beyond a simple ideation aid.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Broad triggers such as planning and requirements combine with MUST/automatic instructions, including a direction not to prompt before continuing into the next phase.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The package contains markdown skill files only, no executable installer, no bundled binary, and no detected malicious static or VirusTotal signal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to save project artifacts, pass all brainstorming context to another skill, dispatch a subagent with spec content, and potentially run a local deferred-capture script if present; these are plausible for planning work but under-scoped for automatic execution.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It persists potentially sensitive planning data to docs/project-brief.md and .attune/brainstorm-session.json, and the spec review loop directs the main agent to edit generated documents automatically.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agentic planning workflow that can write project briefs/session state and automatically hand off to related Attune skills. Avoid using it for confidential strategy, security, legal, or product planning unless you are comfortable with the full brainstorming context being reused by follow-on skills and review agents.
llm.findings:
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified: the artifact requires automatic continuation into project specification and a review loop after brainstorming, with no confirmation unless the user preemptively opts out.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Verified: the artifact requires automatic War Room handoff and full context transfer; this is disclosed in the body but not in the top-level description.
[SDI-2] unexpected: Verified: the skill says all brainstorming context is passed to War Room for multi-LLM deliberation, which is broader than the minimum needed for basic ideation.
[SQP-1] unexpected: Verified: the triggers are broad, and broad activation is more concerning because the skill includes file writes and automatic delegation.
[SQP-2] expected: Verified: writing a project brief and session state is purpose-aligned for a planning skill, but users should know these files may contain sensitive project details.
[EA2] unexpected: Verified: the instruction not to prompt before continuing materially weakens user control in a workflow that writes files and invokes additional skills.
